privileged_info_for_vlm: The target mobile assets MOB-001, MOB-002, and MOB-003 are pre-existing assets in the system. The agent must create the 'Telecom Data' fieldset first to associate it with the 'SIM Cards' category. The SIM assets must be checked out to 'Asset' (MOB-001/2/3) specifically, not to a 'User'.
